description: Get a screenshot file reported in get_last_run results. Returns the image itself (as an image content block, up to 2 MB) plus metadata (existence, size). Accepts the path (absolute or relative) from the screenshots array in get_last_run output. Path must be within the project root.

path.description: Path to the screenshot file, absolute or relative to project root (from last run results)

name: get_screenshot
